reviews.text: Amazing place my dog 🐕 loves going here awesome friendly staff
Good service but a bit slow
My dog Coconut loves OHD! Strongly recommend if you’re looking for a daycare or boarding school for a puppy💗 …

I cannot give enough praise to Oh Hello Dog for everything they’ve done for my dog and I. Recently, our apartment complex caught on fire and my dog and I didn’t have a place to go- Oh Hello Dog took in my pup at the last second so she would be safe while I figured everything out for us. Not only that but they always go above and beyond making sure my puppy's needs are met and that she’s happy and safe. I always trust my dog with the staff at Oh Hello Dog and I cannot recommend them enough!

I've been bringing my Tulsa here for 2 months and I'm so happy! She's a 10 month old great dane and I want to make sure she's properly socialized and knows how to play with dogs smaller than her (so all dogs)! She LOVES getting the car to come here, she wags her tail when she sees everyone who works there and everyone loves my super energetic, sometimes overly energetic puppy. I get report cards on her daily activities and it warms my heart- even on days when she's been marching to her own drum! The best part is she knocks out when we get home because she's beat from a day of play!

Lots of good doggie day cares on DTLA but it is really nice to find a group of people that really care about our dogs, communicate with us and help us with training and socializing.  I can say enough positive things about OHD, and if our pup could talk she would say this is one of the only places she likes to go if we make her leave home

My pup loves coming here!  I appreciated the in-depth review after my pup's initial evaluation and that they have an option for boarding, which I've used for a night up to 10 days. Also, the social updates of the pups' daycare play is …

My dog, Emmie, has been going to OHD for daycare for about 9 months now. I have enrolled her in the day school training program for probably the last 3 months. I have seen a huge improvement in Emmie since she has started at OHD (and …

We love this place! I can barely get my rescue to leave the house (she sees the lease and crates herself) but when I manage to coax her out, after a not so fun car ride, she freaks out when she sees where she's going.  Their day school program is perfect for her as she needs both mental and physical stimulation.  Thank you OHD!

My cattle dog mix, Marcus LaBarcus, loves spending time here. Seeing him get excited as I drop him off  makes me feel so much better whenever I have to travel for work. He comes back happy and tired, proving once and for all that it is in fact possible to wear out an ACD. Cannot recco this spot enough.
The Oh Hello team has been so great with my timid pup. I’m so glad to have found them since I now have to travel for work.

My shy girl Nala is starting to gain confidence and my wild puppy Max helps her out in day school. I love this place so much for my fur babies. They have the best time!!
